author: SickProdigy
description: Private manual Codex usage-cycle estimates and reset reminders with a provider boundary for future official usage data.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each participating Discord user's private reminder schedule, manually entered remaining-percentage estimate, thresholds, and delivery state. It stores no OpenAI credentials, OAuth tokens, account identifiers, prompts, or conversations. Disconnect and Red user-data deletion clear all stored user data.
install_msg: Use [p]codex setup to privately track a reset cycle. OpenAI does not currently expose remaining allowance or reset timestamps to this cog, so it never claims that manual estimates are live account data.
name: Codex
short: Private Codex usage-cycle and reset reminders.
